title: Fine-tuned MedGemma matches EU-TIRADS for thyroid nodule malignancy on ultrasound
summary: MedGemma 1.5 4B was fine-tuned with low-rank adaptation on thyroid ultrasound images from two Tunisian centers (training n = 942, validation 258, test sealed before training n = 256 with 51 malignant). With the radiologist's structured descriptors (Config D), AUROC was 0.953 versus 0.948 for EU-TIRADS, meeting non-inferiority; image-only configurations reached 0.883 to 0.892. Against EU-TIRADS 4 or higher it reclassified 72 of 94 false positives as negative while missing two more cancers, and raw probabilities were miscalibrated. Retrospective, same-centre test set, no external site; positioned as a second reader pending validation.
ai_technology: MedGemma 1.5 4B vision-language model fine-tuned with LoRA

evidence.tested: Sealed patient-level test set of 256 nodules against EU-TIRADS with a fine-needle or histology reference.
evidence.unknown: Prospective external validation; the gain rests on only three cancers in category 4; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Classifies nodules as benign or malignant from images and structured descriptors.
